title: Transaction Monitoring & Anti-Money Laundering (AML) SOP
content: Transaction Monitoring Standards: Financial transactions are monitored in real time using automated rule engines and experimental anomaly detection heuristics. Any transaction exceeding ₹200,000 or greater than 3 times the customer's typical historical amount triggers an automated investigation alert. Consecutive transactions executed within 5 minutes totaling over ₹50,000 trigger a velocity flag. Flagged transactions are placed in an investigation review queue. Customer accounts showing continuous anomalous patterns may be recommended for temporary transaction restrictions pending compliance officer sign-off.

passages.text: Unusual transactions policy: Single transactions exceeding ₹200,000 or 3 times the historical baseline must be flagged for fraud and AML review. Velocity triggers activate when multiple transfers occur within a 5-minute interval.
Account restrictions: When severe suspicious activity or repeated failed payment attempts are detected, agents must submit an Approval Request before freezing or restricting any customer account.
